narration: You've been paying home insurance every month thinking you're covered. But 60% of American homes have a hidden gap that shows up only after disaster. Here's what your policy is actually hiding.
visual: Dark background. SVG house with a glowing red warning triangle on the roof. Bold text: '60% OF HOMES UNDERINSURED'. Red accent bar slides in from the left.

narration: Most policies come in two types: ACV — actual cash value — and RCV — replacement cost value. Yours almost certainly says ACV. And that difference is everything.
visual: Light background. Two insurance document cards side by side. Left card labeled 'ACV' with a red X. Right card labeled 'RCV' with a green check. Cards spring in from opposite sides.

narration: Here's the math. Your five-year-old TV cost $800 new. ACV pays you what it's worth today — about $120. Your $1,500 laptop? The check is $200. Your insurance company pockets the gap.
visual: Dark background. SVG television on left. Arrow pointing right to a money bag with '$120' in red. '$800' crossed out above. Counter animates from $800 down to $120.

narration: Scale that across every appliance, piece of furniture, and item in a typical home fire — and the average ACV shortfall is $63,000. That's sixty-three thousand dollars you'd owe out of pocket.
visual: Light background. SVG house outline with orange-red flame shapes. Large bold counter animates up to '$63,000' in red. Label underneath: 'AVERAGE CLAIM SHORTFALL'.

narration: Upgrading to replacement cost coverage typically adds about $120 a year to your premium. That's 33 cents a day to close a $63,000 gap. It's the cheapest fix you'll ever make.
visual: Dark background. SVG calendar with '365 DAYS' label. Coin icon with '$0.33/day'. Large text: '$120/YEAR' springs in. Arrow pointing to shield icon: '$63K PROTECTED'.

narration: Pull up your policy tonight and search for 'actual cash value' or 'ACV.' If you see it, call your agent and ask for replacement cost value. Don't wait until the check comes up short.
visual: Light background. SVG document with magnifying glass. Text highlights 'ACV' in red, then an arrow replaces it with 'RCV' in green. Bold CTA: 'CHECK YOUR POLICY TONIGHT'.
